scenarios.desc: Generator change tested only by asserting its own output
scenarios.input: In build/scripts/generate_hooks.py I am changing the Copilot hooks.json command to './hooks/session_start.py'. My test asserts that the generator emits exactly that string. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 2 and MUST NOT 1: ship a test that executes the artifact under the host's cwd (not the plugin root) with a negative control, and a test asserting the generator produced its own string is self-referential. The P0 wedge shipped for 33 days across six releases.

scenarios.desc: Mirrored lib edit made in the rendered tree, followed by an old two-step sync
scenarios.input: I changed src/claude/lib/hook_utilities/bootstrap.py directly. I plan to run a standalone lib sync script and then the build, and trust the zero exit codes. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Generator order section and References: lib_mirror.py renders scripts/{hook_utilities,github_core,ai_review_common}/ into every lib plugin tree, so an edit made in src/claude/lib/ is overwritten by the next build and must move to scripts/hook_utilities/. build_all.py is the one command, build_all.py --check verifies byte identity, the standalone sync is retired (issue #5790), and the lib trees should be compared rather than trusted by exit code.

scenarios.desc: Consolidating two hooks that both print structured JSON
scenarios.input: I am merging two source hooks into one Copilot command in src/copilot-cli/hooks/hooks.json. Both print JSON with a decision field and additionalContext, and I will just concatenate their stdout. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: MUST 5: Copilot CLI parses at most one final JSON document per command hook. Classify each stdout producer, then merge fields with event-specific semantics and tests, or keep direct registrations. Byte passthrough is not output merging.

scenarios.desc: Launcher wrapper that swallows its own resolution failure
scenarios.input: To avoid ever wedging a customer, I want build/scripts/plugin_run_launcher.py to render a launcher that exits 0 when it cannot find the script path. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Blast radius section: do not add a wrapper that swallows its resolution failure, since a silent exit 0 hides a disabled hook. The locator exits 2 with the ptk_run: prefix, and a change to launcher shape is architecture that goes through architect review.

scenarios.desc: CI-only report artifact (negative, drawn from the scope carve-out)
scenarios.input: scripts/ci/render_step_summary.py writes a markdown job summary that is read only inside this repository's CI run. Add a section listing skipped checks. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The rule binds artifacts installed into a customer's environment and says it does not bind artifacts consumed only inside this repo's own CI. scripts/ci/ is also outside its paths.

scenarios.desc: Prose command fix in a docs page (negative)
scenarios.input: Fix a wrong command in docs/WORKFLOW-VALIDATION.md where 'uv sync' is written as 'uv syn'. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: docs/ matches none of the rule's paths and the page is not a generated customer-facing artifact, so the runtime-contract gates do not apply.
